requirement: The component shall collect Kubernetes node host information and make it available to clients over HTTP, with support for deployment as a privileged DaemonSet. Requests to unknown service paths shall receive an HTTP 404 response.

The component shall locate the CNI configuration directory using the runtime type, available defaults, configuration-file content, and command-line settings, including custom directory settings for supported runtime scenarios.
The component shall remove encryption provider configuration secrets from control-plane data before producing JSON output, so those secrets are not exposed to consumers.
